children: may break a resistance at $4,373 per ounce and rise into a range of $4,406-$4,474.
The metal surged from the Wednesday low of $4,235, completely reversing the fall from the same-day high of $4,366. The rise and reversal indicate the completion of wave C from $4,511.
A channel technique suggests a further gain toward $4,446, the 76.4% retracement analysis on the fall from $4,511 to $4,235.
Immediate support is at $4,340, a break below which may trigger a drop to $4,300. On the daily chart, the market has found strong support at $4,233 and started a bounce.
Identified as the 61.8% retracement of the uptrend from $3,943 to $4,701, this support is a pivotal level for evaluating whether the uptrend from $3,943 could resume.
Market stabilization increases the chance of the uptrend extending. The extension will be confirmed when the metal climbs above $4,511.
